description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Developer - CLEARED based in the United States. 

 The Cloud Developer will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure supporting critical federal government initiatives. Working across AWS GovCloud and Azure Government environments, you will build automated infrastructure solutions, optimize deployment processes, and strengthen cloud security and reliability. You will leverage Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise cloud technologies to support highly available systems and applications. The role also involves administering collaboration and development platforms while ensuring compliance with federal security and accessibility standards. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering, security, and Agile delivery teams, you will help translate infrastructure requirements into effective technical solutions. This is a remote opportunity with occasional travel or onsite requirements in the Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) area.

Accountabilities:
 You will lead cloud infrastructure development and administration activities, ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient environments across government cloud platforms. You will also automate infrastructure operations, maintain enterprise applications, and collaborate with technical teams to deliver solutions aligned with federal requirements and Agile delivery objectives.


 
 
 
 Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments within AWS GovCloud and Azure Government.







 
 
 
 Develop, configure, and manage AWS infrastructure using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, VPCs, Lambda, and IAM.







 
 
 
 Administer, configure, and optimize the Atlassian Data Center Suite, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and Crowd.







 
 
 
 Automate cloud provisioning and infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Packer, and AWS CloudFormation.







 
 
 
 Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and Bamboo to support secure and continuous infrastructure delivery.







 
 
 
 Monitor system performance, availability, and security using AWS CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.







 
 
 
 Apply cloud security best practices, including IAM policy management, data encryption, network configuration, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and AWS Security Hub integration.







 
 
 
 Manage enterprise identity integrations, including Active Directory, LDAPS, and Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as SAML and OAuth.







 
 
 
 Use containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon ECS, to deploy and manage infrastructure services.







 
 
 
 Troubleshoot infrastructure issues, perform system patching, and execute upgrades in line with enterprise release schedules while minimizing service disruptions.







 
 
 
 Ensure Section 508 accessibility compliance across web-based enterprise applications and collaboration tools.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with systems engineers, software engineers, security personnel, Product Owners, and Scrum Masters to prioritize infrastructure requirements and deliver solutions.







 
 
 
 Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Retrospectives, and System Demos.








 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate will have extensive cloud and infrastructure engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in government cloud environments, automation, security, and enterprise application administration. You should be comfortable working in regulated environments, collaborating across technical disciplines, and contributing to structured Agile delivery processes.


 
 
 
 At least 7 years of experience in cloud development, cloud engineering, or infrastructure engineering.







 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and managing secure cloud environments within AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government.







 
 
 
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, VPCs, Lambda, and IAM.







 
 
 
 Experience administering and configuring the Atlassian Data Center Suite, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and Crowd.







 
 
 
 Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Packer, and AWS CloudFormation.







 
 
 
 Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and Bamboo.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with cloud monitoring, logging, and performance management tools such as CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.







 
 
 
 Knowledge of cloud security principles, including identity and access management, encryption, MFA, network security, and AWS Security Hub.







 
 
 
 Experience with enterprise identity management and authentication technologies, including Active Directory, LDAPS, SAML, and OAuth.







 
 
 
 Working knowledge of Docker and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Amazon ECS.







 
 
 
 Understanding of Section 508 accessibility requirements and their application to enterprise web-based tools.







 
 
 
 Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments and collaborating with cross-functional technical teams.







 
 
 
 Active Secret security clearance or higher is mandatory.








 Benefits: 


 
 
 
 Hourly compensation starting at $50/hour, with final pay rates determined by experience, qualifications, location, and certifications.







 
 
 
 Remote work arrangement.







 
 
 
 Occasional travel to the DMV area may be required for candidates located elsewhere.







 
 
 
 Employee referral program offering payments for qualified professionals who are referred and successfully placed.
